name: Tim Dooley Atlas — Unified Manifest
purpose: The canonical map of the repository. Internal datasets remain modular, but the public atlas presents them as one system with a deliberately small set of human entry points.
public_navigation: Home → Read / Atlas / Timeline / Potatoism / Explore
navigation_rule: Deep surfaces remain public and directly addressable, but they do not all need permanent positions in the global header. The header is a wayfinding spine, not a complete sitemap.
architecture_rule: One body of knowledge, many views. Repository data, canonical identities, relationships, chronology, thought, evidence and research remain separate internally; public navigation should expose the smallest number of meaningful gateways.
information_principle: The objective is maximal useful understanding, not maximal file count or navigation count. Consolidate valuable information into substantial canonical records, dossiers, source collections and relationship structures.
consolidation_rule: One concept has one canonical identity and definition owner. Other appearances are occurrences, evidence, research, relationships, chronology or projections.
fallback: If an optional live source fails, local repository-backed data remains authoritative for navigation and available content. Live enrichment is additive.
anti_clutter_rule: Do not create placeholder files, shallow duplicate entries or separate records merely because a new layer has a slightly different name. A new artifact earns existence only when it has a distinct function, canonical owner, consumer and information that would otherwise be lost or materially obscured.
